fullPassage: Just like how other rooms in your home can cause anxiety when filled with too much stuff, the same is true for kids. If the play space houses every single toy that has ever been purchased for them since birth, they may not be able to express their feelings, but they can feel overwhelmed by so much stuff. This reminds us of how women look in their closets packed full of clothes and think, I have nothing to wear. __________ helps everyone see what they have and use what they own. When there's too much to see, too much input, kids have a hard time making a choice. Streamlining a play space is so important. You want your kids to feel inspired and imaginative in the room — not overcome with indecision.

❌ ① filling: rooms are filled(수동), 능동 filling 불가 → filled
✅ ② houses: the play space(단수) → 단수동사
✅ ③ making: have a hard time -ing 구문
✅ ④ inspired: feel + 형용사(보어) 정상

questions.passage: Just like how other rooms in your home can cause anxiety when filled with too much stuff, the same is true for kids. If the play space houses every single toy that has ever been purchased for them since birth, they may not be able to express their feelings, but they can feel overwhelmed by so much stuff. This reminds us of how women look in their closets packed full of clothes and think, I have nothing to wear. __________ helps everyone see what they have and use what they own. When there's too much to see, too much input, kids have a hard time making a choice. Streamlining a play space is so important. You want your kids to feel inspired and imaginative in the room — not overcome with indecision.
